key_insight: HorizON jointly learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories to predict organic battery behavior across multiple cycling horizons.
engineering_relevance: Modeling the full battery stack and usage conditions could support long-term performance prediction, inverse design, and process optimization beyond active-material selection alone.
method: Extend a data-fusion multi-task framework from single-valued targets to cycle-by-cycle prediction.
Use a multi-fidelity, multi-horizon Deep Operator Network to learn redox potentials and capacity trajectories jointly.
Train on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions to capture component interactions.
evidence_signal: The abstract identifies DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent capacity trajectories as training targets but reports no dataset sizes, evaluation metrics, or quantitative results.
watch_item: Generalization to unseen stack chemistries, operating conditions, and cycling horizons requires validation not reported in the abstract.
paper_title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
